Method of Attack: Improper user validation allowing low-level authenticated users to download latest database backups containing credentials and PII by crafting valid links and manipulating the 'send backup via email' function normally restricted to administrators
Exploitation of missing permission checks on backup nonce identifier and timestamps
Impacted Systems: WordPress sites using UpdraftPlus plugin versions 1.16.7 to 1.22.2
Attack Vector: Authenticated user accounts on WordPress sites with UpdraftPlus plugin
Indicators of Compromise: High-severity vulnerability with CVSS v3.1 score of 8.5
